register: Nairobi WRC 2007 — Article 1 definitions + derived terms

definitions.text: exclusive economic zone of a State Party, established in accordance with international law or, if not established, an area beyond and adjacent to the territorial sea extending not more than 200 nautical miles from baselines
definitions.note: Default = EEZ; optional Art. 3.2 extension to territory/territorial sea available.

definitions.text: (a) sunken/stranded ship; (b) any part of such ship incl. objects on board; (c) objects lost at sea from a ship stranded/sunken/adrift; (d) ship about to sink/strand where no effective assistance measures are being taken
definitions.note: Four limbs - includes lost containers and ships about to sink/strand.

definitions.text: (a) danger/impediment to navigation; OR (b) may reasonably be expected to result in major harmful consequences to marine environment, or damage to coastline/related interests of one or more States
ships of 300 gross tonnage or more
